elements.text:
There are three stages. /bMagic Cloth/z is the plain stuff, made at a bench. /bMagic Thread/z is cloth spun back together over the brazier. /bEnhanced Magic Cloth/z is cloth soaked in /bLiquid Magic/z.

  Enhanced cloth and thread are what the /bWizard Robes/z are made of. Each piece is worked onto a matching piece of iron armour at the brazier, so the set costs you a full set of iron as well.

  Each piece guards you as well as iron would, and mends on an anvil with Magic Cloth. On their own that is all they do. Wear all four at once and they start paying you back.
